title: Pokémon: Hisuian Snow
synopsis:
Get ready for a new adventure set in the vast, stunning Hisui region, the location of Pokémon LEGENDS: Arceus. 

Yuki Hodokishi Futaai tells the story of a boy named Akio and his encounter with a Hisuian Zorua. When he was younger, Akio's father taught him that people and Pokémon cannot live together. But Akio's interactions with the Zorua might offer a different lesson.

(Source: Pokemon.com)

episodes.title: Onto the Icy Blue
episodes.synopsis: Across the Hisui region, many grow up believing people and Pokémon cannot live together. But when Alec meets a Hisuian Zorua, he may need to rethink how he views Pokémon!

episodes.title: Fiery Reflections in Snow
episodes.synopsis: After tumbling off a steep cliff, Alec and Hisuian Zorua work together to climb back up. But when Alec returns with a Pokémon in tow, he’s shocked by his father’s reaction!

episodes.title: Two Hues
episodes.synopsis: While remembering his time with Hisuian Zorua, the older Alec finally arrives in the Hisui region. But the question remains: what became of their friendship?
